text:
rachel (sre): Postmortem follow-up: recurring pattern of autoscaler backfills + cold KV. last incident produced ~40m of elevated p99 and 25% throughput loss. Rather than ad-hoc p99 relaxes we should create a short 'SLO playbook' for scale windows.

ben (infra): +1. short-term mitigation done (stagger node joins), but infra needs to export a "ramp_event" tag and ramp_index metric. i'll own infra telemetry and tagging. ETA 24h.

kai (serving): serving remedies: KV pre-warm, soft batch caps during ramps, and a fallback model pool. i'll own pre-warm + routing changes. ETA 48h for canary, 72h for full rollout.

olga (product): product request: define customer-facing policy and opt-in for a throughput-oriented SLO during bursts. we'll prepare comms and SLA impact table. i'll own comms + legal loop. ETA 36h.

alert-bot: Incident INC-2026-210 recorded: autoscaler backfill correlated with KV misses.

rachel (sre): Proposed compact playbook (for immediate rollout):
- Detect ramp (ramp_index > 0.7) or autoscaler_join tag
- For duration of ramp (10m window) evaluate a burst SLO (throughput p95) instead of counting latency p99
- Allow error-budget reallocation up to 2% per-customer during ramp windows
- Add dashboard annotations + alert that SLO shift occurred

ben (infra): i'll push tag export and ramp_index metric PR and add dashboard panel. PR ETA: 18h.

kai (serving): i'll add metrics: kv_warm_pct, fallback_rate, burst_credit_balance. alerts: "kv_warm_pct < 80% for 10m" and "fallback_rate > 5% for 5m". will stage canary in 24h.

olga (product): action items:
- olga (product): draft customer FAQ + SLA matrix (due 36h)
- ben (infra): ramp_index + event tagging + panels (due 24h)
- kai (serving): pre-warm + batch cap + alerts (due 72h)
- rachel (sre): SLO config PR + decision note (due 12h)

rachel (sre): i've opened PR stub: https://git.redwood/slo-config/pulls/1201 - contains playbook and tests. please review inline.

ben (infra): added temporary annotation to SLO dashboard noting incident window and tag=autoscaler_backfill.

kai (serving): canary started, initial telemetry looks good (kv_warm_pct ~91%). posting canary logs to the PR.

olga (product): will prep a one-paragraph comms draft and share with legal for sign-off.

rachel (sre): scheduling a 3-day checkpoint to decide opt-in vs default change and to review error-budget burn. calendar: https://cal.link/3day-slo-check. closing thread; update with PR/alert links here. :white_check_mark:
